predict_tracks: predict tracks for a sequence of images and return tracks, visibility scores, confidence, 3D points, and colors
predict_tracks_with_fine_tracking: run track prediction with fine tracking enabled and complete non-visible frame augmentation
augment_non_visible_frames: augment tracking results for frames with insufficient visibility using fallback keypoint extractors
forward_on_query: process a single query frame to extract keypoints and predict corresponding tracks across all frames
predict_tracks_with_sift: predict tracks using sp+sift+aliked keypoint extractor for improved feature detection
